dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid, symmetrical linear 2D narrowing of the visible body mass towards a sharp posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-grey baseline skin tone with a significantly higher-reflectance (lighter) central longitudinal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency dark-grey veining and subtle patches distributed across the lateral dorsal planes.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between the darker mottled regions and the lighter grey baseline skin.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single, distinct high-contrast white circular mark on the right posterior lateral margin near the interface with water turbulence.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small white punctate lesion or temporal mark on the right lateral margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent, high-reflectance longitudinal ridge running along the sagittal plane of the dorsal surface.
